svg.text: Tuned configs. Broker on CPUs 0-3, load generator (zzq_brokerbench, raw sockets) on CPUs 4-5. 1 s warmup, then 5 s.
Throughput is delivered messages. rumqttd speaks MQTT 3.1.1, the rest 5.0. Round trips at QoS 0 and 1 only.
Intel Core i7-8700B @ 3.20 GHz (KVM), performance governor, turbo off
16 pairs: 16 publishers → 16 subscribers, a topic each
round trip, 1 message in flight: p99, whiskers p50 to p99.9
